description: Use this when the user wants a Sankey diagram, flow diagram or alluvial-style chart of amounts moving between stages, for example a budget (income to spending), an energy balance, a sales funnel or website traffic paths. Takes flows as from, to and amount (pasted text or a list), up to 200 flows and 100 nodes, plus a title, unit, node order, link colour and PDF page size. Returns node totals, a balance table, totals per column, a proportion check of link widths and node heights, label overlap results, an interactive diagram, and SVG, PDF and CSV downloads. Refuses loops, flows from a node to itself, zero or negative amounts and ambiguous amounts such as 1,234 without a decimal_mark. Does not read files, fetch data from other apps or save diagrams.

color_by.description: Link colour, e.g. source (default: each link takes the colour of the node it leaves) or target (the node it enters).

decimal_mark.description: Decimal mark of the amounts, "." (1,234.50) or "," (1.234,50). Needed only when an amount such as 1,234 or 1.234 could be read both ways; otherwise it is read from the amounts.

flows.description: Alternative to flows_text: [{"from":"Salary","to":"Budget","amount":"4000"}]. The amount may be text ("1,250.50") or a number. Up to 200 flows and 100 different nodes.

flows_text.description: Flows pasted as text, one per line: from, to, amount, e.g. "Salary,Budget,4000\nBudget,Rent,1500\nBudget,Savings,800". Comma, tab or semicolon between values; an optional header row is skipped; names with commas go in double quotes. Up to 200 lines. Give this or flows.

node_order.description: auto (default): nodes in each column are arranged to reduce crossings; given: nodes keep the order they first appear in the flows.

page_size.description: PDF page: auto (default, the page fits the diagram at full size up to the 200 in PDF page limit; a larger diagram is scaled down and the result says so), letter or a4 (scaled to one page).

title.description: Diagram title, e.g. "Monthly budget". Default "Sankey diagram".

unit.description: Unit or currency shown with amounts, e.g. "$", "€", "kWh" or "users". A single currency symbol goes before the number, other units after it.

name: make_sankey
title: Make Sankey diagram
